howto.name: Upload a text file or paste text
howto.text: Select a .txt file up to 500 MB or paste plain text directly into the editor.

howto.name: Choose formatting
howto.text: Pick the font family, font size, page size, and margins. Monospace fonts work best for code or tabular content.

howto.name: Generate the PDF
howto.text: Click Convert. The text is reflowed into paginated PDF pages with the selected formatting.

faq.q: Can I change the font and page size?
faq.a: Yes. Choose from several font families (serif, sans-serif, monospace), set the font size, and select A4 or Letter page size with custom margins.

faq.q: Does the tool handle Unicode text?
faq.a: Yes. UTF-8 encoded text is fully supported, including non-Latin scripts like Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic, and Devanagari.

faq.q: Is there a character or line limit?
faq.a: No character limit beyond the 500 MB file-size cap. The text is automatically reflowed and paginated.
